title: Conditions & validation
outcome: Make boundaries, missing evidence and decision order explicit.

steps.title: 1. Express the rule
steps.text: Translate wording into a truth table before choosing operators. A value at a threshold may belong on either side; the contract decides.

steps.title: 2. Select one branch
steps.text: if/elif/else stops at the first matching branch. Put exceptional cases before ordinary categories.

steps.title: 3. Combine conditions
steps.text: and requires both conditions; or accepts either; not reverses a boolean. Short-circuiting can protect a later expression from an invalid operation.
steps.code:
value = None
valid = value is not None and value >= 0

steps.title: 4. Validate types
steps.text: In Python bool is a subclass of int. Use type(value) is int when a protocol requires an integer and forbids booleans. Syntax validity is distinct from operational acceptability.
steps.code:
print(isinstance(True, int))  # True
print(type(True) is int)     # False

steps.title: 5. Prove the boundaries
steps.text: For every range, test just below, exactly at, and just above the boundary. Never label a device healthy because its observation is missing.
